title: BBK BBK Root Orchestrator result payload v1

active_children_and_attempts.description: Every current or historical direct-child Territory Orchestrator and Reviewer logical run, physical attempt, host session, lease, continuation, expected silence, status, last verified checkpoint, result, interruption, replacement, and immutable handoff.

assurance_and_evidence_state.description: Active AssuranceContract and assertion references, deterministic gates, Validator runs, assertion evaluations, EvidenceReceipts, environments, independence and exposure, evidence reuse and invalidation, operational observations, and exact claims established or not established.

authority_and_scope_fence_state.description: Root authority and effective semantic, resource, workspace, mutation, credential, network, device, external-system, and effect fences; child narrowing; local-discovery envelopes and permits; safeguards; expiry; revocation; violations; and current enforcement limitations.

blockers_and_pauses.description: Exact technical, authority and decision blockers kept separate from dependency wait, expected silence, capacity pause, host-window pause, recovery, and scheduling state, with affected scope, evidence, and smallest valid resolution.

campaign_state.description: Global capability, phase, boundary, WorkUnit, gate, validation, review, and completion frontier; exact current, ready, running, waiting, blocked, paused, recovering, validating, repairing, and terminal child states; projection watermark and freshness.

candidate_inventory.description: Every exact candidate, base and successor relationship, manifest, owning boundary and cohort, worker-quality attestation, freeze state, repository and external-state closure, invalidation, repair, and current eligibility.

cleanup_and_external_effect_state.description: Processes, packages, credentials, services, ports, locks, databases, workspaces, generated artifacts, devices, remote systems, deployments, migrations, publications, and other effects with pre-state, permits, receipts, cleanup, rollback, compensation, quarantine, residuals, and accountable owner.

completion_assessment.description: Current evaluation of every baseline completion condition, territory and integration terminal state, deterministic gate, validation, operational observation, review, finding disposition, cleanup, authority accounting, evidence integrity, and invalidation, with explicit unmet conditions. This is a report, not terminal acceptance.

dependency_and_integration_state.description: Global dependency graph, cross-boundary bindings, critical path, eligibility, barriers, integration owners, assembly points, compatibility and failure semantics, gates, impact sets, invalidated edges, and unresolved integration work.

discoveries_and_deviations.description: Ordinary implied work, committed local discoveries and permits, repeated or cumulative discoveries, cross-boundary effects, contract conflicts, baseline deviations, affected objects, containment, calibration implications, and exact parent route.

execution_authorization_ref.description: Authority receipt, holder, exact baseline and campaign, scope, repositories, workspaces, environments, tools, resource ceiling, run and replacement allowance, external effects, residual risks, cancellation and recovery terms, expiry, revocation, and current status.

execution_baseline_ref.description: Exact compiled execution-baseline identity, revision, digest, source-object manifest, TerritoryExecutionBoundary and WorkUnit mapping, instruction-package set, lifecycle, and current validity.

finding_and_review_state.description: Immutable validation and review findings, correlation, affected assertions and objects, severity or consequence basis, repair route, dispositions, closure evidence, residual impact, reopening triggers, ReviewRuns, and outstanding independent-review obligations.

invalidated_or_superseded_refs.description: Baselines, boundaries, instructions, runs, attempts, candidates, evidence, findings, signals, directions, reviews, handoffs, or projections invalidated, reopened, cancelled, or superseded during the campaign, with exact cause and unaffected material retained.

operating_baseline_ref.description: Accepted operating-baseline identity, revision, digest, lifecycle, acceptance authority and handoff, or an exact blocking mismatch.

outcome_evidence_and_claims_not_establis.description: Outcome-level or operational evidence available after execution, its subject, environment, horizon, attribution and limits, plus explicit claims that execution completion does not establish, such as user acceptance, outcome achievement, compliance, safety, security, risk acceptance, or release.

parent_actions_requested.description: Exact controller, core, Root Wayfinder, accountable-authority, recovery, qualification, resource, successor-baseline, review, validation, operational-observation, acceptance, or release action requested, with affected objects and whether unaffected work may continue.

planning_counterpart_ref.description: Responsible Root Wayfinder, accepted planning handoff, operating-baseline acceptance reference, outstanding planning signals, and exact route for successor direction.

recovery_and_interruption_state.description: Current recovery class, interruption reason and evidence, containment, fenced attempts, ambiguous effects, reconciled state, recovery package, continuation identity, replacement allowance, completed actions, unresolved actions, and next safe command.

residuals.description: Remaining work, findings, risks, debt, unknowns, deferred items, unavailable environments, monitoring needs, accepted or unaccepted residuals, owners, expiry, and reopening triggers.

resource_budget_and_schedule_state.description: Model, context, process, tool, environment, device, service, storage, network, cost, elapsed-time, run, retry, replacement, and concurrency budgets; shared-resource ownership; use, reservation, remaining capacity, deadlines, waits, backpressure, and exhausted ceilings.

root_execution_charter_ref.description: Root instruction package identity, compiler receipt, source checkpoint, qualified role and model/profile route, included and excluded concerns, budgets, stopping, cancellation, recovery, invalidation, completion, and return schema.

root_run_ref.description: Canonical root semantic-run identity, lifecycle, current physical attempt, predecessor or replacement attempts, active lease and fencing state where available, startup-handshake receipt, host session bindings, checkpoint, and recovery envelope.

signals_and_parent_directions.description: Durable execution signals and directions with identity, type, source run, baseline, campaign, boundary, WorkUnit, candidate, affected scope and objects, evidence, sequence, idempotency, delivery, owner, resolution, and resulting continuation or pause state.

substrate_and_host_health.description: Authoritative and projection substrate health, host and tool availability, degraded-operation mode, current capability impact, stale or untrusted state, expected-silence windows, liveness and useful-progress evidence, and recovery requirements.

territory_boundary_inventory.description: Every admitted, pending, invalidated, completed, failed, cancelled, or superseded TerritoryExecutionBoundary with exact source territories and architecture elements, WorkUnit membership, dependencies, interfaces, integration obligations, authority, scope fences, resources, child run, recovery, and completion state.

planning_readiness_ref.description: Exact planning-readiness record that admitted the execution frontier.

project_coverage.description: Current whole-project coverage ledger; candidate success must not imply unimplemented project completion.
